title: Locally finite type morphisms induce essentially finite type stalk maps
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$. Then the induced homomorphism of local rings $f_x^\sharp:\mathcal O_{S,s}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra].
